purpose: Estimate the dominant blocking layer of the frozen EnvSolve-pro algorithm before designing the next intervention.
claim_scope: Consumed development diagnostics only; no held-out effectiveness claim.

decision_order: success when the official evaluator passes
evaluator_gap when an internally certified candidate reaches an official evaluation that fails
observability_gap when the best complete zero-exit effect-valid candidate retains unknown constraints
closure_gap when the best complete zero-exit effect-valid candidate has zero unknowns but residual active constraints
operation_nonviability when no complete zero-exit effect-valid candidate exists

primary_analysis.statistic: case count and share in each blocking category
primary_analysis.dominant_contradiction: the unique category with the largest case count

decision_rule: Freeze the aggregate census before changing the algorithm. Design at most one next intervention against the dominant category; do not add repository-specific rules.
infrastructure_policy: Archive and exclude attempts that fail before candidate execution because of host, credential, network, or container infrastructure; reruns retain provenance.
prediction: operation_nonviability or closure_gap will account for a strict majority of the eight cases.
